费明兰越了解原治之，越被他的才华与品性所折服，虽然夫妻二人婚后聚少离多，但是费明兰并没有因此而埋怨恼恨，她知道自己的丈夫和景国一样，都在做着最紧张的准备，朝着那个「天下一统」的千古基业大踏步迈进。

容香其实之前就有心仪的男子，是宫廷中的一位待卫，她只等着玄昱的大业成功，然后就自请离开原家，改嫁情郎。

容香跟随着原治之四处游走，是为了完成玄昱交付的任务，她也曾和费明兰私下讲过自己的情况。

而费明兰相信原治之的操守。

原治之允诺妻子，此生不会背弃两人洞房之夜「一生一代一双人」的誓言，那么，费明兰就相信他一定会做到。

费明兰第一胎生女之后，她和母亲一样都有点沮丧，原治之却浑然不在意，反而笑道：「生儿生女都是咱们的孩子，你这做母亲的怎么能偏心呢？而且啊，女儿是要娇养的，更要加倍疼爱才行。」

费明兰依然有点郁闷，就因为知道原治之的性情，不会乱找女人乱生孩子，她才更想尽早为他生下嫡子，生下只属于他们二人的儿子。

费明兰不想重蹈母亲的覆辙，忍着心痛去给丈夫纳妾生庶子，但是她更不想丈夫真的绝嗣。

那么她唯一能做的，就是亲自努力多生几个孩子，希望多有几个男娃娃了。

生女儿是用来疼爱的，生儿子却是一种需要，社会现象如此，费明兰也并不想特立独行。

越有才华能力的人，人们越希望他能留下子嗣，不希望这样优秀的血脉就此断绝。

去年，原治之终于又恢复了与原府的交往，但并未重回家谱。

他曾与自己，的父亲原北顾畅谈了一宿，表示以后会自建自己这一系的家谱，并且家谱中绝不会有庶子，什么时候没嫡子，就任凭绝嗣。

费明兰摸了摸自己鼓胀胀的肚子，细心感受着腹中宝贝的胎动，嘴里喃喃道：「就要到预产期了，不知道你爹爹能不能赶回家呢？」

这次怀孕后不久，原治之就出远门了，一直到现在还没返家。前不久他捎家信来，说一定会赶在孩子出生之前归家。

「娘！娘！」原嘉睛玩累了，转身就要扑到母亲的怀早，奶娘急忙从后面拦抱住她。

「小姐，太太肚子里有小宝宝，你可不能这样扑过去喔，会压到宝宝的。」奶娘柔声细气地劝说道。

原嘉睛嘟着嘴，有点闹别扭，她觉得娘自从有了小宝宝后，就没那么疼爱她了。

她乌溜溜的大眼睛滴溜溜转了转，忽然发现草坪尽头的青石板道上走来了几个人，其中一人还穿着明黄色绣着龙的华丽衣服，立即吸引了她的注意力。

费明兰也发现了这队非凡的人马，她简直不敢相信，皇帝居然会御驾亲临余姚县这个小地方。

她想上前跪迎，可是肚子却突然剧烈疼痛起来，让她双腿一阵发软，几乎己经站不住。

立春急了，急忙吩咐周围的女佣们：「快，搀扶太太进房间，这是快要生了！石榴，别管那傻鸟了，快去吩咐稳婆做好准备。」

玄导没想到自己刚到桃源别庄，就遇到了女主人生孩子。

啧啧……他这是什么命格啊？似乎与孩子格外有缘。

费明兰在产房努力生育她的长子时，并不知道她已经被赐封为了正三品诰命夫人。

前不久，玄昱下旨增设了「商部」，与吏、户、礼、兵、刑、工六部并重，原治之出任首任商部尚书。

此举虽然存朝野引起大哗然，却并没有阻断玄昱与原治之的决心，商部正式运转了起来，原治之的工作也算稳定下来了，日后他会长年在京城工作、生活，所以这次是回乡来迎接妻女回京的。

但是没想到皇帝因为大业即将成功，太兴奋兼太无聊，非要跟着出来散心，携带多病体弱的嫡长子玄潜来了个微服私访，美其名为玄潜调养身体。

原嘉睛仰着桃花一般粉嫩嫩的小脸，好奇地打量着乖乖坐在玄昱身边，同样穿着绣龙衣服的小皇子，她眨着乌溜溜的大眼睛，觉得他长得可真好看呀，比她见过的所有人都好看。

在大人们说着话的时候，原嘉瞎悄悄地、一点一点地挪到了玄潜的身边，试探着用手指戳了戳玄潜比桃花还柔软好看的脸蛋。

已经五岁的玄潜看起来只有三四岁大一点，漂亮得惊人，却也而色苍白，明显不是很健康。

他同样好奇地看着身前胖嘟嘟的小女娃，她真可爱啊，粉嫩得让人想咬一口。

原嘉睛忽然掀起玄潜的小袍子，伸手就要去退他的裤子。

这下不仅原治之大感丢脸，就连玄昱这个皇帝都目瞪口呆。

小女娃这么早就知道调戏他的宝贝儿子了？

玄潜急忙脸红红地按住自己的裤子，拍打原嘉睛的手，道：「你、你走开！」

原嘉睛却踮着脚尖朝他裤子中间探看，大喊：「哇！小鸡鸡！」

一屋子人绝倒。

原尚书家到底养了个什么样的女儿？

原治之一脸窘样抱起自家女儿，先向皇帝和皇子道歉，然后才问女儿：「你在搞什么呢？太失礼了！」

原嘉睛搂住父亲的脖子，嘟着花瓣一样娇嫩的小嘴唇，道：「立春家的小哥哥说，有小鸡鸡的是男孩子，爹和娘有了男孩子，就不会疼我了。我讨厌小鸡鸡。」

玄潜在父亲的帮助下重新系好腰带，听了这话，忍不住瞪了原嘉睛一眼，「我也讨厌小女娃娃，母后有了妹妹都不疼我了。」

原嘉睛瞪回他，嘟着嘴巴「哼」了一声，然后钻进爹爹的怀里撒娇，问：「爹爹，娘生了弟弟，你还疼不疼我？」

「爹爹最疼你。」

原嘉睛满意地喜笑颜开。

恰巧此时稳婆抱着刚出生的婴儿走出产房，高声道：「恭喜原老爷，是一个大胖小子，母子均安。」

原治之微微一笑，下令厚赏。

玄昱也凑热闹，赏了刚出生的胖小子一枚玉佩。

随行而来的其他侍卫官员们，都说着吉祥奉承话，什么弄璋之喜，有后不愁等等。

被冷落在一边的原嘉睛扁着小嘴，大眼睛里很快就滚出了豆大的泪珠，泪珠盈着睫毛，欲掉不掉，看起来格外惹人怜爱。

玄潜忍不住走过去拉起她的小手，笨拙地为她擦泪，「妹妹，别哭，别哭。」

原嘉睛委屈道：「爹爹骗人，爹爹也不疼我了，鸣……」

「别哭，别哭，以后我疼你。」

「真的？」

「真的。」

「你发誓！」

「好。」

两只小手紧紧地拉在了一起，两个顽童相视而笑，却不知命运的红线也借机缠绕到了他们的小手指上，将他们的未来紧紧牵系在了一起。

「原大人，晚上一起去喝杯酒？」

下朝之后，户部尚书刘大人喊住了步履匆匆的商部尚书原治之。

己过而立之年的原治之俊美依旧，连式样刻板的朝服都能穿出芝兰玉树的味道，让其他的大人们只能羡慕嫉妒不己。

难怪整个金陵城早的青楼都流传着原大人是超级美男子的传说，甚至还有名妓作诗赞颂呢。

其他的大人作了诗歌赞美名妓，名妓也未必能青睬他们，人家原治之连面都不用露，名妓却上赶着巴结。

这是什么样的差距啊？

和这样的人同朝为官，简直是悲剧。

平素大家是不乐意邀请原治之一起去外面喝花酒的，因为只要有他在场，其他人就自动沦落成了配角，而且是无人搭理的配角。
content_en:
The more Fei Minglan got to know Yuan Zhizhi, the more impressed he was by his talent and character. Although the couple got together less and separated more after marriage, Fei Minglan did not complain or resent it. She knew that her husband, like Jing Guo, was making the most intense preparations and striding forward towards the eternal foundation of "unification of the world".

Rong Xiang actually had a man she liked before, who was a guard in the palace. She just waited for Xuan Yu's great career to succeed, and then asked herself to leave her original family and remarry her lover.

Rong Xiang followed Yuan Zhizhi around to complete the tasks assigned by Xuan Yu. She also talked to Fei Minglan about her situation in private.

And Fei Minglan believed in Yuan Zhizhi's integrity.

Yuan Zhizhi promised his wife that he would never break the vow they made on their wedding night to "be a couple for a lifetime," so Fei Minglan believed that he would definitely do it.

After Fei Minglan gave birth to her first daughter, she was a little depressed like her mother, but Yuan Zhizhi didn't care at all. Instead, he smiled and said: "Both children and daughters are our children. How can you, a mother, be partial? Besides, daughters must be pampered, and they must be loved even more."

Fei Minglan was still a little depressed. Just because she knew Yuan Zhizhi's temperament and would not find random women to have children, she wanted to give birth to his legitimate son as soon as possible and give birth to a son that belonged only to the two of them.

Fei Minglan didn't want to make the same mistake as her mother, enduring the heartache to give birth to a concubine for her husband, but she didn't want her husband to really have an heir.

Then the only thing she can do is to work hard to have more children, hoping to have more boys.

Giving birth to a daughter is for love, but giving birth to a son is a need. The social phenomenon is like this, and Fei Minglan does not want to be independent.

The more talented and capable a person is, the more people hope that he can leave an heir, and do not want such an excellent bloodline to be cut off.

Last year, Hara Harazhi finally resumed contact with Yuan Fu, but did not return to the family tree.

He once had a long talk with his father, Yuan Beigu, and said that he would build his own family tree in the future, and that there would never be a bastard in the family tree. Whenever there was no legitimate son, he would be extinct.

Fei Minglan touched her swollen belly, carefully feeling the movement of the baby in her belly, and murmured: "It's almost the due date. I wonder if your father can make it home?"

Not long after this pregnancy, Hara Zhizhi went away from home and has not returned home until now.Not long ago, he sent a letter home, saying that he would return home before the child was born.

"Mom! Mom!" Yuan Jiaqing was tired of playing and turned around to throw herself into her mother's arms. The wet nurse hurriedly stopped her and hugged her from behind.

"Miss, there is a baby in my wife's belly. You can't rush over like this, or you will crush the baby." The nanny persuaded her softly.

Yuan Jiaqing pouted, feeling a little awkward. She felt that her mother didn't love her so much since she had the baby.

Her big dark eyes rolled around, and she suddenly noticed a few people walking on the bluestone path at the end of the lawn. One of them was wearing a bright yellow dress embroidered with a dragon, which immediately attracted her attention.

Fei Minglan also discovered this extraordinary team. She couldn't believe that the emperor would actually visit this small place in Yuyao County.

She wanted to kneel forward to greet him, but she suddenly felt severe pain in her stomach, which made her legs weak and she could hardly stand.

Li Chun was anxious and hurriedly ordered the maids around him: "Quick, help my wife into the room, she is about to give birth! Pomegranate, don't worry about that stupid bird, go and tell Po Wen to get ready."

Director Xuan did not expect that as soon as he arrived at Taoyuan Villa, he would meet the hostess and give birth to a child.

Tsk tsk... What kind of destiny is he?He seems to have a special affinity with children.

When Fei Minglan was trying to give birth to her eldest son in the delivery room, she didn't know that she had been given the title of Madam of the Third Grade.

Not long ago, Xuan Yu decreed that the "Business Department" should be added, with equal emphasis on the six departments of officials, households, rituals, military affairs, punishment, and industry. Hara Zhizhi became the first Shangshu of the Ministry of Commerce.

Although this move caused a huge uproar in both the government and the public, it did not block the determination of Xuan Yu and Yuan Zhizhi. The Ministry of Commerce was officially operational, and Yuan Zhizhi's job was stabilized. He would work and live in the capital for many years in the future, so this time he returned to his hometown to welcome his wife and daughter back to the capital.

But he didn't expect that the emperor was too excited and bored because his great cause was about to succeed, so he insisted on going out to relax. He brought his eldest son Xuan Qian, who was sick and frail, to pay a private visit incognito, and called Xuan Qian to nurse himself back to health.

Yuan Jiaqing looked up at his peach blossom-like pink face and curiously looked at the little prince who was sitting next to Xuan Yu, also wearing dragon-embroidered clothes. She blinked her big black eyes and thought he was really good-looking, better-looking than anyone she had ever seen.

While the adults were talking, Yuan Jiabao quietly moved to Xuan Qian's side little by little, and tentatively poked Xuan Qian's face, which was softer and more beautiful than a peach blossom, with his finger.

Xuan Qian, who was already five years old, looked only a little older than three or four years old. He was astonishingly beautiful, but also pale and obviously not very healthy.

He also looked at the chubby little girl in front of him with curiosity. She was so cute, so pink that it made people want to take a bite.

Yuan Jiaqing suddenly lifted up Xuan Qian's robe and reached out to take off his pants.

Now not only Yuan Zhi was embarrassed, but even the emperor Xuan Yu was dumbfounded.

Did the little girl know about teasing his precious son so early?

Xuan Qian hurriedly held down his pants with a blushing face, slapped Yuan Jiaqing's hand and said, "You, you go away!"

However, Yuan Jiaqing stood on tiptoes and looked into the middle of his pants, shouting, "Wow! Small penis!"

A room full of people collapsed.

What kind of daughter did the former minister raise?

Hara Jiichi looked embarrassed and picked up his daughter. He first apologized to the emperor and the prince, and then asked his daughter: "What are you doing? It's so rude!"

Yuan Jiaqing hugged her father's neck, pouted her petal-like lips, and said, "The little brother in Lichun's family said that those with small penises are boys. If my father and mother have a boy, they won't love me. I hate small penises."

Xuan Qian fastened his belt again with the help of his father. After hearing this, he couldn't help but glared at Yuan Jiaqing, "I also hate little girls. After my mother has a sister, she doesn't love me anymore."

Yuan Jiaqing stared back at him, pouted and said "hum", then got into her father's arms and acted coquettishly, asking: "Dad, Mom has given birth to a younger brother, do you still love me?"

"Daddy loves you the most."

Yuan Jiaqing beamed with satisfaction.

It happened that at this time, Mrs. Wen walked out of the delivery room with the newborn baby in her arms and said loudly: "Congratulations to Mr. Yuan, he is a big fat boy. Both mother and baby are safe."

Yuan Zhizhi smiled slightly and ordered a generous reward.

Xuan Yu also joined in the fun and rewarded the newborn fat boy with a jade pendant.

The other guards and officials who came along all said auspicious and flattering words, such as how happy they were to have a happy marriage, how they would not worry about the future, etc.

Yuan Jiaqing, who was left out in the cold, had her mouth flat, and big tears quickly rolled out of her big eyes. The teardrops filled her eyelashes and refused to fall. She looked particularly endearing.

Xuan Qian couldn't help but walked over and took her little hand, clumsily wiping her tears, "Sister, don't cry, don't cry."

Yuan Jiaqing said aggrievedly: "Daddy is lying, and daddy doesn't love me anymore, Ming..."

"Don't cry, don't cry, I will love you from now on."

"Really?"

"Really."

"You swear!"

"Okay."

The two little hands were tightly pulled together, and the two urchins looked at each other and smiled, but they didn't know that the red thread of fate also took the opportunity to wrap around their little fingers, tightly tying their future together.

"Master Hara, let's go have a drink together tonight?"

After the next court, Mr. Liu, the Minister of Hubu, stopped the hurriedly walking Minister of Shang, Yuan Zhizhi.

The thirty-year-old Yuan Zhi is still handsome, and even the rigid court clothes can bring out the flavor of Zhilan Yushu, which makes other adults can only envy him.

No wonder the legend that Lord Yuan was a super handsome man spread throughout the early brothels in Jinling City, and even famous prostitutes wrote poems to praise him.

Other adults wrote poems in praise of the famous prostitutes, but the famous prostitutes may not be able to pay attention to them. They didn't even have to show their faces, but the famous prostitutes were busy fawning over them.

What kind of gap is this?

It is simply a tragedy to serve as an official in the same court as such a person.

Normally, everyone is not willing to invite Hara Zhizhi to drink wine outside, because as long as he is present, others are automatically reduced to supporting roles, and they are supporting roles that no one cares about.
